content.title: Spring 2026 Academic Calendar | Office of the Registrar
content.text: All dates are tentative until closer to the beginning of the semester. UG = Undergraduate students; GRAD = Graduate students Part of Term (POT) values indicate the time frame for the course. The Class Schedule shows what part of term each course is scheduled in to assist with identifying deadlines. Non-standard course offerings will not have a POT but start and end dates are shown in the Section Details on Course Explorer: 1 = full 16 week semester (approximately 1/20/2026 – 5/6/2026 plus finals) A = first 8 weeks of the semester (approximately 1/20/2026 – 3/13/2026) B = second 8 weeks of the semester (approximately 3/16/2026 – 5/6/2026 plus finals. Classes begin 3/23/2026 after spring break Non-standard course offerings will not have a POT and do not follow the dates and deadlines on this calendar. Please refer to the non-standard tables on the withdrawal and refund webpages for deadline details. Start and end dates are shown in the Section Details on Course Explorer. 2025-2026 Senate Academic Calendar Undergraduate student registration deadlines by POT in an easy to read chart.Graduate and Professional student registration deadlines by POT in an easy to read chart. Graduation and Degree Certification deadlines October 6 Spring and Winter Class Schedules are available on Course Explorer October 20 Time Tickets (earliest registration times) for Spring 2026 priority registration available to view on Student Self-Service Open time tickets will be assigned the following day November 3 Priority registration begins for Spring and Winter 2026 for eligible continuing and returning students November 20 Open registration for Spring 2026 begins for new and all other students January 12 Spring tuition and fee charges first appear on student accounts January 17 – February 20 Health Insurance Change/Waiver Period January 19 11:59 PM CST Deadline to cancel registration (dropping all Spring 2026 classes) for full reversal of tuition and campus fees for classes scheduled in a regular semester This date does not apply to Non-standard course offerings. The deadline to cancel is the day prior to the first day of the course. January 20 First day of instruction for Spring POT 1 (full semester) and POT A (1st 8 week) courses January 26 Deadline for ALL to add a POT A course via Student Self-Service Deadline for ALL to drop POT A course for refund if tuition range changes or billing hours decrease Deadline to suppress directory information February 2 – “10th day” add/drop deadline Deadline for ALL to drop or reduce POT 1 (full semester) hours and receive refund if tuition range changes or billing hours decrease. Deadline for ALL to add a POT 1 (full semester) course via Student Self-Service Deadline for ALL to change credit hours on variable credit courses via Student Self-Service Deadline for ALL to submit request to Audit a class Deadline for GRAD to submit request for in-absentia status via the Graduate College Student Portal Deadline for Undergraduate & Vet Med students to apply to graduate in May via Student Self-Service. After this date, please contact your Academic Office for assistance. February 3 Official spring enrollment information transmitted to NSC for processing to NSLDS to provide loan deferment if applicable. Notification to federal loan providers should occur within 2 – 3 weeks. February 13 Deadline for ALL to drop a POT A (1st 8 week) course via Student Self-Service without grade of W Deadline for UG to elect credit/no credit or change credit/no credit to regular grade basis in POT A course Deadline for UG to file intent to use Campus Grade Replacement option in POT A course February 27 Deadline for GRAD to drop a POT A (1st 8 week) course via Graduate Student Portal without a grade of W Deadline for GRAD to elect credit/no credit for a POT A course or to change from credit/no credit to a regular grade February 28 Full payment due for Spring 2026 charges unless on a payment plan. Visit Pay My Bill for more information regarding payment options and due dates. March 2 Midterm grade entry enabled for Instructors in Faculty Self-Service March 9 Summer and Fall Class Schedules are available on Course Explorer March 10 at 2:00 PM Faculty deadline for reporting midterm grades for freshmen March 11 Final Exam schedule posted to Office of Registrar website and Course Explorer POT A (1st 8 week) grade entry enabled for Instructors in Faculty Self-Service March 13 Deadline for ALL to drop POT 1 (full semester) course via Student Self-Service without grade of W Deadline for UG to remove incomplete grade from previous semester to prevent change to F grade Deadline for UG to elect credit/no credit or change credit/no credit to regular grade basis in POT 1 course Deadline for UG to file intent to use Campus Grade Replacement option in POT 1 course Deadline for UG to withdraw from Spring 2026 semester (drop all courses) without grade of W Deadline for LAW to drop semester course without grade of W March 14–22 Spring Break March 23 POT B (2nd 8 week) courses begin (non-standard courses may begin earlier or later) March 27 Deadline for ALL to add POT B (2nd 8 week) course via Student Self-Service Deadline for ALL to drop POT B course for refund if tuition range changes or billing hours decrease 2:00 PM Faculty deadline for reporting POT A (1st 8 week) grades. Students can view grades the following day via Student Self-Service or myIllini March 30 Priority registration Time Tickets (earliest registration times) for Summer and Fall 2026 available on Student Self-Service April 3 Deadline to withdraw from the university and receive the minimum 40% pro-rata refund if enrolled mainly in full semester classes April 5 Deadline for Graduate, Law & Medicine students to apply to graduate in May via Student Self-Service. After this date, please contact your Academic Office for assistance. April 6 Priority registration for Summer and Fall 2026 begins Graduation Application opens for Summer and Fall 2026 in Student Self-Service. Instructions can be found on the Graduation FAQs. POT A (1st 8 week) grade entry reenabled for instructors in Faculty Self-Service. Any grades submitted at this time will not be viewable until after final grade entry. April 17 Deadline for ALL to drop POT B (2nd 8 week) course via Student Self-Service without grade of W Deadline for UG to elect credit/no credit or change credit/no credit to regular grade basis in POT B course Deadline for UG to file intent to use Campus Grade Replacement option in POT B course Deadline for GRAD to drop POT 1 (full semester) course via Graduate Student Portal without a grade of W Deadline for GRAD to elect credit/no credit or change credit/no credit to regular grade basis in POT 1 course Last day for GRAD to withdraw from Spring 2026 semester without grade of W when enrolled mainly in full semester classes April 23 Open registration begins for Summer and Fall 2026 May 1 Deadline for GRAD to drop POT B (2nd 8 week) course via Graduate Student Portal without a grade of W Deadline for GRAD to elect credit/no credit or change credit/no credit to regular grade basis for POT B course May 4 Final grade entry enabled for Instructors in Faculty Self-Service May 6 Last day of instruction May 7 Reading day (no classes, no final examinations) Last day for GRAD to add/drop POT 1 or POT B course without petitioning Graduate College May 8–14 Weekdays only Final examination period (Colleges of Law and Vet Med may extend to May 15) May 16 Degree conferral and campus-wide commencement. Diplomas will be shipped in approximately 9 weeks May 22 at 2:00 PM Faculty deadline for reporting grades. Students can view final grades the following day via Student Self-Service or myIllini May 29 2:00 PM Faculty deadline for reporting LAW grades College deadline for reporting Academic Standing. Students can view status the following day via Student Self-Service or myIllini. June 1 Transcripts on hold for Spring 2026 grades are released June 12 at 2:00 PM Faculty deadline for reporting ZJUI grades. Students can view final grades the following day via Student Self-Service or myIllini. June 22 College deadline for reporting Dean’s List. Undergraduate students can view status the following day via Student Self-Service. June 23 Transcripts on hold for Spring 2026 degrees are released
